tests.name: manual visual inspection at full size and 720p
tests.method: ffmpeg frame extraction at 0.5 s, 5 s and 10.5 s at native 4096x2160, plus one frame scaled to 720 px height; each viewed at full size
tests.result: All frames show a beige CRT monitor and keyboard on a desk in a dim room with a slow camera drift, screen blank and dark throughout. No boot, no power-on, no POST, no memory count, no BIOS screen, no OS. No PC case or tower in frame, so no CPU is visible. No watermark or baked-in caption. At full resolution the monitor bezel is legible as a ViewSonic E70 - a monitor make and model, not a CPU, system or date, and not Pentium evidence; at 720p neither marking is legible.
